title: The agent harness
sub: The model picks each action; the harness around it decides what the model can see, what may run, and when to stop.

nodes.l: context policy trims old tool results
model sees the denial and stops

steps.d:
"What does the DW-300's drain pump cost, and
how long is it under warranty?"

steps.h: The model calls a tool from what the registry offers
Your code runs the search and returns three sections
steps.d:
dw300-manual#9, warranty-policy#2, care-and-cleaning-guide#2
("2-year full warranty" is in warranty-policy#2)

steps.h: The context policy decides what of that the model still sees
steps.d:
keep_everything: the full result stays in context
trim_to_budget(15): the same result is replaced with a placeholder
steps.m: 0 or 260 tokens kept, depending on the policy in force

steps.h: The model tries a second action
A hook vetoes it before the registry ever runs it
steps.d: deny_after(1): "tool budget of 1 call(s) already spent"
steps.m: 0 ms — the tool function never runs

steps.h: Told the call was denied, the model answers with what it has
steps.d:
The search result was trimmed and the part lookup never ran, so:
"I could not confirm the price or the warranty term from what's
in front of me."
